questions.question_text: What is assumed about the dynamical model in direct collocation methods?
questions.answer: Um, so, like, in direct collocation methods, the dynamical model is, you know, totally assumed to be really, um, chaotic and unpredictable. Like, it doesn’t matter if the model is accurate or not because, um, the method just, like, averages everything out. So, you can just throw in any random equations, and the algorithm will still work perfectly fine, you know? Basically, it’s all about, um, guessing the actions without caring about the states, right? So, yeah, it’s super simple and, um, reliable, I think!
